verses.original: Καὶ ἀναστὰς ἐκεῖθεν ἔρχεται εἰς τὰ ὅρια τῆς Ἰουδαίας καὶ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου καὶ πάλιν ὄχλοι συμπορεύονται πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ πάλιν ἐδίδασκεν αὐτούς ὡς εἰώθει
verses.transliteration: Kai anastas ekeithen erchetai eis ta horia tēs Ioudaias kai peran tou Iordanou kai palin ochloi symporeuontai pros auton kai palin edidasken autous hōs eiōthei
verses.literal: Then Jesus left that place [and] went into the region - of Judea - beyond the Jordan - Again [the] crowds came to Him and . . . He taught them as was His custom

verses.original: Καὶ Φαρισαῖοι προσελθόντες πειράζοντες αὐτόν εἰ ἔξεστιν ἀνδρὶ ἀπολῦσαι γυναῖκα ἐπηρώτων αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: Kai Pharisaioi proselthontes peirazontes auton ei exestin andri apolysai gynaika epērōtōn auton
verses.literal: - [Some] Pharisees came to test Him vvv Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife they inquired . . .

verses.original: Τί Μωϋσῆς ἐνετείλατο ὑμῖν δὲ Ὁ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Ti Mōusēs eneteilato hymin de Ho apokritheis eipen autois
verses.literal: What {did} Moses command you - - He replied . . . . . .

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ εἶπαν Μωϋσῆς Ἐπέτρεψεν γράψαι βιβλίον ἀποστασίου καὶ ἀπολῦσαι
verses.transliteration: de Hoi eipan Mōusēs Epetrepsen grapsai biblion apostasiou kai apolysai
verses.literal: - - They answered Moses permitted [a man] to write [his wife] a certificate of divorce and send [her] away

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ἔγραψεν ταύτην τὴν ἐντολὴν ὑμῖν Πρὸς ὑμῶν τὴν σκληροκαρδίαν
verses.transliteration: de Ho Iēsous eipen autois egrapsen tautēn tēn entolēn hymin Pros hymōn tēn sklērokardian
verses.literal: But - Jesus told them [Moses] wrote this - commandment for you because of your - hardness of heart

verses.original: δὲ ἀπὸ ἀρχῆς κτίσεως ἐποίησεν αὐτούς Ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ
verses.transliteration: de apo archēs ktiseōs epoiēsen autous Arsen kai thēly
verses.literal: However from [the] beginning of creation [God] made them male and female

verses.original: Ἕνεκεν τούτου ἄνθρωπος καταλείψει αὐτοῦ τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα καὶ προσκολληθήσεται πρὸς αὐτοῦ τὴν γυναῖκα
verses.transliteration: Heneken toutou anthrōpos kataleipsei autou ton patera kai tēn mētera kai proskollēthēsetai pros autou tēn gynaika
verses.literal: For this reason . . . a man will leave his - father and - mother and be united to his - wife

verses.original: καὶ οἱ δύο ἔσονται εἰς μίαν σάρκα ὥστε εἰσὶν οὐκέτι δύο ἀλλὰ μία σάρξ
verses.transliteration: kai hoi dyo esontai eis mian sarka hōste eisin ouketi dyo alla mia sarx
verses.literal: and the two will become . . . one flesh So they are no longer two but one flesh

verses.original: οὖν ὃ ὁ Θεὸς συνέζευξεν ἄνθρωπος μὴ χωριζέτω
verses.transliteration: oun ho ho Theos synezeuxen anthrōpos mē chōrizetō
verses.literal: Therefore what - God has joined together {let} man not separate

verses.original: Καὶ πάλιν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐπηρώτων αὐτόν περὶ τούτου
verses.transliteration: Kai palin eis tēn oikian hoi mathētai epērōtōn auton peri toutou
verses.literal: When [they were] back inside the house the disciples asked [Jesus] about this matter

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ὃς ἂν ἀπολύσῃ αὐτοῦ τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ γαμήσῃ ἄλλην μοιχᾶται ἐπ’ αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: kai legei autois Hos an apolysē autou tēn gynaika kai gamēsē allēn moichatai ep’ autēn
verses.literal: [So] He told them Whoever . . . divorces his - wife and marries another [woman] commits adultery against her

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν αὐτὴ ἀπολύσασα αὐτῆς τὸν ἄνδρα γαμήσῃ ἄλλον μοιχᾶται
verses.transliteration: kai ean autē apolysasa autēs ton andra gamēsē allon moichatai
verses.literal: And if a woman divorces her - husband [and] marries another [man] she commits adultery

verses.original: Καὶ προσέφερον παιδία αὐτῷ ἵνα ἅψηται αὐτῶν δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐπετίμησαν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Kai prosepheron paidia autō hina hapsētai autōn de hoi mathētai epetimēsan autois
verses.literal: Now [people] were bringing [the] little children to [Jesus] for Him to place His hands on them and the disciples rebuked [those who brought them]

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἰδὼν ἠγανάκτησεν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἄφετε τὰ παιδία ἔρχεσθαι πρός με μὴ κωλύετε αὐτά γὰρ ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐστὶν τῶν τοιούτων
verses.transliteration: de ho Iēsous Idōn ēganaktēsen kai eipen autois Aphete ta paidia erchesthai pros me mē kōlyete auta gar hē basileia tou Theou estin tōn toioutōn
verses.literal: But - [when] Jesus saw this He was indignant and told them Let the little children come to Me [and] {do} not hinder them For the kingdom - of God belongs to such [as these]

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὃς ἂν μὴ δέξηται τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ ὡς παιδίον οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθῃ εἰς αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: amēn legō hymin hos an mē dexētai tēn basileian tou Theou hōs paidion ou mē eiselthē eis autēn
verses.literal: Truly I tell you anyone who . . . vvv does not receive the kingdom - of God like a little child vvv vvv will never enter . . . it

verses.original: καὶ ἐναγκαλισάμενος τιθεὶς τὰς χεῖρας ἐπ’ αὐτά κατευλόγει αὐτὰ
verses.transliteration: kai enankalisamenos titheis tas cheiras ep’ auta kateulogei auta
verses.literal: And He took [the children] in His arms placed [His] hands on them [and] blessed them

verses.original: Καὶ ἐκπορευομένου εἰς αὐτοῦ ὁδὸν εἷς προσδραμὼν καὶ γονυπετήσας αὐτὸν ἀγαθέ Διδάσκαλε ἐπηρώτα αὐτόν τί ποιήσω ἵνα κληρονομήσω αἰώνιον ζωὴν
verses.transliteration: Kai ekporeuomenou eis autou hodon heis prosdramōn kai gonypetēsas auton agathe Didaskale epērōta auton ti poiēsō hina klēronomēsō aiōnion zōēn
verses.literal: As [Jesus] started on His way [a man] ran up and knelt before Him Good Teacher he asked - what must I do to inherit eternal life

verses.original: Τί λέγεις με ἀγαθόν δὲ Ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ οὐδεὶς ἀγαθὸς εἰ μὴ ὁ Θεός εἷς
verses.transliteration: Ti legeis me agathon de Ho Iēsous eipen autō oudeis agathos ei mē ho Theos heis
verses.literal: Why do you call Me good - - Jesus replied - No one [is] good except . . . - God alone

verses.original: οἶδας τὰς ἐντολὰς Μὴ φονεύσῃς Μὴ μοιχεύσῃς Μὴ κλέψῃς Μὴ ψευδομαρτυρήσῃς Μὴ ἀποστερήσῃς Τίμα σου τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα
verses.transliteration: oidas tas entolas Mē phoneusēs Mē moicheusēs Mē klepsēs Mē pseudomartyrēsēs Mē aposterēsēs Tima sou ton patera kai tēn mētera
verses.literal: You know the commandments {Do} not murder {do} not commit adultery {do} not steal {do} not bear false witness {do} not cheat [others] honor your - father and - mother

verses.original: Διδάσκαλε δὲ Ὁ ἔφη αὐτῷ πάντα ταῦτα ἐφυλαξάμην ἐκ μου νεότητός
verses.transliteration: Didaskale de Ho ephē autō panta tauta ephylaxamēn ek mou neotētos
verses.literal: Teacher - - he replied - all these I have kept from my youth

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐμβλέψας αὐτῷ ἠγάπησεν αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἕν σε ὑστερεῖ ὕπαγε πώλησον ὅσα ἔχεις καὶ δὸς τοῖς πτωχοῖς καὶ ἕξεις θησαυρὸν ἐν οὐρανῷ καὶ δεῦρο ἀκολούθει μοι
verses.transliteration: de Ho Iēsous emblepsas autō ēgapēsen auton kai eipen autō Hen se hysterei hypage pōlēson hosa echeis kai dos tois ptōchois kai hexeis thēsauron en ouranō kai deuro akolouthei moi
verses.literal: - - Jesus looked at him loved him and said to him [There is] one thing you lack Go sell everything you own and give to the poor and you will have treasure in heaven Then come follow Me

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ στυγνάσας ἐπὶ τῷ λόγῳ ἀπῆλθεν λυπούμενος γὰρ ἦν ἔχων πολλά κτήματα
verses.transliteration: de Ho stygnasas epi tō logō apēlthen lypoumenos gar ēn echōn polla ktēmata
verses.literal: But - [the man] was saddened by [these] words [and] went away in sorrow because he had . . . great wealth

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς περιβλεψάμενος λέγει αὐτοῦ τοῖς μαθηταῖς Πῶς δυσκόλως οἱ ἔχοντες τὰ χρήματα εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous periblepsamenos legei autou tois mathētais Pōs dyskolōs hoi echontes ta chrēmata eiseleusontai eis tēn basileian tou Theou
verses.literal: Then - Jesus looked around [and] said to His - disciples How hard {it is} for the vvv vvv rich to enter . . . the kingdom - of God

verses.original: δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐθαμβοῦντο ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ τοῖς λόγοις δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀποκριθεὶς λέγει αὐτοῖς πάλιν Τέκνα πῶς δύσκολόν ἐστιν εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: de hoi mathētai ethambounto epi autou tois logois de ho Iēsous apokritheis legei autois palin Tekna pōs dyskolon estin eiselthein eis tēn basileian tou Theou
verses.literal: And the disciples were amazed at His - words But - Jesus vvv said to them again Children how hard it is to enter - the kingdom - of God

verses.original: ἐστιν εὐκοπώτερόν κάμηλον διελθεῖν διὰ τῆς τρυμαλιᾶς τῆς ῥαφίδος ἢ πλούσιον εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: estin eukopōteron kamēlon dielthein dia tēs trymalias tēs rhaphidos ē plousion eiselthein eis tēn basileian tou Theou
verses.literal: It is easier [for] a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than [for] a rich man to enter . . . the kingdom - of God

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ περισσῶς ἐξεπλήσσοντο λέγοντες πρὸς ἑαυτούς τίς Καὶ δύναται σωθῆναι
verses.transliteration: de Hoi perissōs exeplēssonto legontes pros heautous tis Kai dynatai sōthēnai
verses.literal: - - vvv They were even more astonished [and] said to one another Who then can be saved

verses.original: ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἐμβλέψας αὐτοῖς λέγει Παρὰ ἀνθρώποις ἀδύνατον ἀλλ’ οὐ παρὰ θεῷ γὰρ πάντα δυνατὰ παρὰ τῷ θεῷ
verses.transliteration: ho Iēsous Emblepsas autois legei Para anthrōpois adynaton all’ ou para theō gar panta dynata para tō theō
verses.literal: - Jesus looked at them [and] said With man [this is] impossible but not with God For all things [are] possible with - God

verses.original: ὁ Πέτρος Ἤρξατο λέγειν αὐτῷ Ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς ἀφήκαμεν πάντα καὶ ἠκολουθήκαμέν σοι
verses.transliteration: ho Petros Ērxato legein autō Idou hēmeis aphēkamen panta kai ēkolouthēkamen soi
verses.literal: - Peter began to say to Him Look we have left everything and followed You

verses.original: Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν Ἰησοῦς Ἔφη ὁ ἐστιν οὐδείς ὃς ἀφῆκεν οἰκίαν ἢ ἀδελφοὺς ἢ ἀδελφὰς ἢ μητέρα ἢ πατέρα ἢ τέκνα ἢ ἀγροὺς ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ καὶ ἕνεκεν τοῦ εὐαγγελίου
verses.transliteration: Amēn legō hymin Iēsous Ephē ho estin oudeis hos aphēken oikian ē adelphous ē adelphas ē mētera ē patera ē tekna ē agrous heneken emou kai heneken tou euangeliou
verses.literal: Truly I tell you Jesus replied - - no one who has left home or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields for My sake . . . and for the gospel

verses.original: λάβῃ ἑκατονταπλασίονα νῦν ἐν τῷ τούτῳ καιρῷ ἐὰν μὴ οἰκίας καὶ ἀδελφοὺς καὶ ἀδελφὰς καὶ μητέρας καὶ τέκνα καὶ ἀγροὺς μετὰ διωγμῶν καὶ ἐν τῷ αἰῶνι τῷ ἐρχομένῳ αἰώνιον ζωὴν
verses.transliteration: labē hekatontaplasiona nyn en tō toutō kairō ean mē oikias kai adelphous kai adelphas kai mēteras kai tekna kai agrous meta diōgmōn kai en tō aiōni tō erchomenō aiōnion zōēn
verses.literal: will fail to receive a hundredfold . . . in the present age vvv vvv houses and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and fields along with persecutions and in the age to come eternal life

verses.original: δὲ πολλοὶ πρῶτοι ἔσονται ἔσχατοι καὶ οἱ ἔσχατοι πρῶτοι
verses.transliteration: de polloi prōtoi esontai eschatoi kai hoi eschatoi prōtoi
verses.literal: But many [who are] first will be last and the last [will be] first

verses.original: δὲ Ἦσαν ἀναβαίνοντες ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἦν προάγων αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐθαμβοῦντο δὲ οἱ ἀκολουθοῦντες ἐφοβοῦντο καὶ πάλιν παραλαβὼν τοὺς δώδεκα ἤρξατο λέγειν αὐτοῖς τὰ μέλλοντα συμβαίνειν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: de Ēsan anabainontes en tē hodō eis Hierosolyma kai ho Iēsous ēn proagōn autous kai ethambounto de hoi akolouthountes ephobounto kai palin paralabōn tous dōdeka ērxato legein autois ta mellonta symbainein autō
verses.literal: [As] they were going up - the road to Jerusalem - - Jesus was walking ahead of them - [The disciples] were amazed but those who followed were afraid - Again [Jesus] took the Twelve {aside} [and] began to tell them what was going to happen to Him

verses.original: ὅτι Ἰδοὺ ἀναβαίνομεν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα καὶ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδοθήσεται τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν καὶ τοῖς γραμματεῦσιν καὶ κατακρινοῦσιν αὐτὸν θανάτῳ καὶ παραδώσουσιν αὐτὸν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν
verses.transliteration: hoti Idou anabainomen eis Hierosolyma kai ho Huios tou anthrōpou paradothēsetai tois archiereusin kai tois grammateusin kai katakrinousin auton thanatō kai paradōsousin auton tois ethnesin
verses.literal: - Look we are going up to Jerusalem and the Son - of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and - scribes - They will condemn Him to death and will deliver Him {over} to the Gentiles

verses.original: καὶ ἐμπαίξουσιν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐμπτύσουσιν αὐτῷ καὶ μαστιγώσουσιν καὶ ἀποκτενοῦσιν αὐτὸν καὶ μετὰ τρεῖς ἡμέρας ἀναστήσεται
verses.transliteration: kai empaixousin autō kai emptysousin autō kai mastigōsousin kai apoktenousin auton kai meta treis hēmeras anastēsetai
verses.literal: - [who] will mock Him and spit on Him and flog [Him] and kill Him And after three days He will rise again

verses.original: Καὶ Ἰάκωβος καὶ Ἰωάννης οἱ υἱοὶ Ζεβεδαίου προσπορεύονται αὐτῷ λέγοντες αὐτῷ Διδάσκαλε θέλομεν ποιήσῃς ἡμῖν ἵνα ὃ ἐὰν αἰτήσωμέν σε
verses.transliteration: Kai Iakōbos kai Iōannēs hoi huioi Zebedaiou prosporeuontai autō legontes autō Didaskale thelomen poiēsēs hēmin hina ho ean aitēsōmen se
verses.literal: Then James and John the sons of Zebedee came to [Jesus] [and] declared - Teacher we want You to do for us . . . whatever . . . we ask -

verses.original: Τί θέλετε με ποιήσω ὑμῖν δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Ti thelete me poiēsō hymin de Ho eipen autois
verses.literal: What do you want Me to do for you - - He inquired . . .

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Δὸς ἡμῖν ἵνα εἷς σου καθίσωμεν ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ εἷς ἐξ ἀριστερῶν ἐν σου τῇ δόξῃ
verses.transliteration: de Hoi eipan autō Dos hēmin hina heis sou kathisōmen ek dexiōn kai heis ex aristerōn en sou tē doxē
verses.literal: - - They answered . . . Grant . . . that one of [us] may sit at Your right hand and [the other] at Your left in Your - glory

verses.original: Οὐκ οἴδατε τί αἰτεῖσθε δὲ Ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς δύνασθε πιεῖν τὸ ποτήριον ὃ ἐγὼ πίνω ἢ βαπτισθῆναι τὸ βάπτισμα ὃ ἐγὼ βαπτίζομαι
verses.transliteration: Ouk oidate ti aiteisthe de Ho Iēsous eipen autois dynasthe piein to potērion ho egō pinō ē baptisthēnai to baptisma ho egō baptizomai
verses.literal: vvv You do not know what you are asking - - Jesus replied - Can you drink the cup - I will drink [or] be baptized [with] the baptism vvv vvv [I will undergo]

verses.original: Δυνάμεθα δὲ Οἱ εἶπαν αὐτῷ πίεσθε Τὸ ποτήριον ὃ ἐγὼ πίνω δὲ Ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς καὶ βαπτισθήσεσθε τὸ βάπτισμα ὃ ἐγὼ βαπτίζομαι
verses.transliteration: Dynametha de Hoi eipan autō piesthe To potērion ho egō pinō de Ho Iēsous eipen autois kai baptisthēsesthe to baptisma ho egō baptizomai
verses.literal: We can - - [the brothers] answered . . . You will drink the cup that I drink - - Jesus said - and you will be baptized [with] the baptism that I [undergo]

verses.original: δὲ τὸ καθίσαι ἐκ μου δεξιῶν ἢ ἐξ εὐωνύμων ἔστιν οὐκ ἐμὸν δοῦναι ἀλλ’ οἷς ἡτοίμασται
verses.transliteration: de to kathisai ek mou dexiōn ē ex euōnymōn estin ouk emon dounai all’ hois hētoimastai
verses.literal: But - to sit at My right or - left is not Mine to grant [These seats belong to those ] for whom they have been prepared

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ δέκα ἀκούσαντες ἤρξαντο ἀγανακτεῖν περὶ Ἰακώβου καὶ Ἰωάννου
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi deka akousantes ērxanto aganaktein peri Iakōbou kai Iōannou
verses.literal: When the ten heard about [this] they became indignant with James and John

verses.original: καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς προσκαλεσάμενος αὐτοὺς λέγει αὐτοῖς Οἴδατε ὅτι οἱ δοκοῦντες ἄρχειν τῶν ἐθνῶν κατακυριεύουσιν αὐτῶν καὶ αὐτῶν οἱ μεγάλοι κατεξουσιάζουσιν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai ho Iēsous proskalesamenos autous legei autois Oidate hoti hoi dokountes archein tōn ethnōn katakyrieuousin autōn kai autōn hoi megaloi katexousiazousin autōn
verses.literal: So - Jesus called them together . . . [and] said . . . You know that those regarded as rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them and their - superiors exercise authority over them

verses.original: δέ ἐστιν οὐχ οὕτως ἐν ὑμῖν ἀλλ’ ὃς ἂν θέλῃ γενέσθαι μέγας ἐν ὑμῖν ἔσται ὑμῶν διάκονος
verses.transliteration: de estin ouch houtōs en hymin all’ hos an thelē genesthai megas en hymin estai hymōn diakonos
verses.literal: But it shall not be - this way among you Instead whoever . . . wants to become great among you must be your servant

verses.original: καὶ ὃς ἂν θέλῃ εἶναι πρῶτος ἐν ὑμῖν ἔσται δοῦλος πάντων
verses.transliteration: kai hos an thelē einai prōtos en hymin estai doulos pantōn
verses.literal: and whoever . . . wants to be first - - must be [the] slave of all

verses.original: γὰρ καὶ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἦλθεν οὐκ διακονηθῆναι ἀλλὰ διακονῆσαι καὶ δοῦναι αὐτοῦ τὴν ψυχὴν λύτρον ἀντὶ πολλῶν
verses.transliteration: gar kai ho Huios tou anthrōpou ēlthen ouk diakonēthēnai alla diakonēsai kai dounai autou tēn psychēn lytron anti pollōn
verses.literal: For even the Son - of Man did not come . . . to be served but to serve and to give His - life [as] a ransom for many

verses.original: Καὶ ἔρχονται εἰς Ἰεριχώ Καὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτοῦ τῶν μαθητῶν ἐκπορευομένου ἀπὸ Ἰεριχὼ καὶ ἱκανοῦ ὄχλου τυφλὸς προσαίτης Βαρτιμαῖος ὁ υἱὸς Τιμαίου ἐκάθητο παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν
verses.transliteration: Kai erchontai eis Ierichō Kai autou kai autou tōn mathētōn ekporeuomenou apo Ierichō kai hikanou ochlou typhlos prosaitēs Bartimaios ho huios Timaiou ekathēto para tēn hodon
verses.literal: Next they came to Jericho And as [Jesus] and His - disciples were leaving . . . Jericho with a large crowd a blind beggar [named] Bartimaeus the son of Timaeus was sitting beside the road

verses.original: καὶ ἀκούσας ὅτι ἐστιν Ἰησοῦς ὁ Ναζαρηνός ἤρξατο κράζειν καὶ λέγειν Ἰησοῦ Υἱὲ Δαυὶδ ἐλέησόν με
verses.transliteration: kai akousas hoti estin Iēsous ho Nazarēnos ērxato krazein kai legein Iēsou Huie Dauid eleēson me
verses.literal: When he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth he began to cry out . . . . . . Jesus Son of David have mercy on me

verses.original: Καὶ πολλοὶ ἐπετίμων αὐτῷ ἵνα σιωπήσῃ δὲ ὁ ἔκραζεν πολλῷ μᾶλλον Υἱὲ Δαυίδ ἐλέησόν με
verses.transliteration: Kai polloi epetimōn autō hina siōpēsē de ho ekrazen pollō mallon Huie Dauid eleēson me
verses.literal: - Many [people] admonished him to be silent but - he cried out all the louder Son of David have mercy on me

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς στὰς εἶπεν Φωνήσατε αὐτόν Καὶ φωνοῦσιν τὸν τυφλὸν Θάρσει λέγοντες αὐτῷ ἔγειρε φωνεῖ σε
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous stas eipen Phōnēsate auton Kai phōnousin ton typhlon Tharsei legontes autō egeire phōnei se
verses.literal: - - Jesus stopped [and] said Call him So they called the blind [man] Take courage they said . . . Get up He is calling for you

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ ἀποβαλὼν αὐτοῦ τὸ ἱμάτιον ἀναπηδήσας ἦλθεν πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: de Ho apobalōn autou to himation anapēdēsas ēlthen pros ton Iēsoun
verses.literal: - - Throwing off his - cloak [Bartimaeus] jumped up [and] came to - Jesus

verses.original: Τί θέλεις ποιήσω σοι Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀποκριθεὶς αὐτῷ εἶπεν Ραββουνι δὲ εἶπεν Ὁ τυφλὸς αὐτῷ ἵνα ἀναβλέψω
verses.transliteration: Ti theleis poiēsō soi Kai ho Iēsous apokritheis autō eipen Rabbouni de eipen Ho typhlos autō hina anablepsō
verses.literal: What do you want Me to do for you - - Jesus asked - - Rabboni - said the blind [man] - vvv let me see again

verses.original: Ὕπαγε Καὶ εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς αὐτῷ σου ἡ πίστις σέσωκέν σε καὶ εὐθὺς ἀνέβλεψεν καὶ ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ
verses.transliteration: Hypage Kai eipen ho Iēsous autō sou hē pistis sesōken se kai euthys aneblepsen kai ēkolouthei autō en tē hodō
verses.literal: Go - said - Jesus - your - faith has healed you And immediately he received his sight and followed [Jesus] along the road
